
/* ============================================================
   湖南大学考研题库 · Academy Design System
   ============================================================
   技能释放:
   - taste-skills: 千年学府书卷气 · 东方文人克制 · 留白呼吸
   - impeccable: 像素级精致 · 每一处对齐 · 每个阴影过渡
   - emilkowalski: 毛玻璃质感 · 弹簧物理 · 深度层次 · SF式图标语言
   ============================================================
   视觉调研依据:
   - 校徽: 岳麓书院正门/岳麓山/毛泽东题写校名/976&1926/十四瓣枫叶
   - 校训: 实事求是 敢为人先 (2001年确立)
   - 建筑: 飞檐翘角/头门/御书楼重檐/千年学府匾
   - 标准色: 红(红墙·枫叶)/绿(麓山·湘水)/白(象牙白)
   - 校徽红 CMYK 40/100/100/10
   ============================================================ */

/* ===== CSS 自定义属性 ===== */
/* ============================================================
   湖南大学考研题库 · Academy Design System
   taste-skill: 千年学府书卷气 · 东方文人克制 · 留白呼吸
   impeccable: 像素级精致 · 多层柔和阴影 · 统一圆角
   apple-design: 弹簧物理 · 深度层次 · 毛玻璃质感
   ============================================================ */

/* ===== CSS 自定义属性 ===== */
:root{
  --bg-image:none;--logo-image:none;--emblem-image:none;

  /* 岳麓色系 — 亮色主题 */
  --red:#B5343A;--red-deep:#8B1A2B;
  --red-subtle:rgba(181,52,58,.07);--red-glow:rgba(181,52,58,.16);
  --red-surface:rgba(181,52,58,.04);--red-border:rgba(181,52,58,.12);

  --paper:#F9F6F0;--paper-warm:#F3EDE4;
  --surface:#FFFFFF;--surface-raised:#FCFAF7;
  --ink:#1C1917;--ink-soft:#5C5650;--ink-faint:#8A827C;
  --ink-line:rgba(28,25,23,.06);

  --pine:#3D6B52;--pine-subtle:rgba(61,107,82,.07);
  --pine-glow:rgba(61,107,82,.14);--pine-border:rgba(61,107,82,.12);

  --gold:#B8935A;--gold-subtle:rgba(184,147,90,.08);
  --gold-border:rgba(184,147,90,.15);

  --blue:#4A6FA5;--blue-subtle:rgba(74,111,165,.07);
  --blue-glow:rgba(74,111,165,.14);--blue-border:rgba(74,111,165,.12);

  --water:#5B7D8C;--water-subtle:rgba(91,125,140,.07);
  --mist:#D4CFC8;--mist-subtle:rgba(212,207,200,.12);

  /* 毛玻璃 */
  --glass-bg:rgba(255,255,255,.58);
  --glass-blur:saturate(170%) blur(32px);
  --glass-border:rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  --glass-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(28,25,23,.06),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);

  /* 圆角系统 — impeccable 统一 */
  --r-xs:9px;--r-sm:14px;--r-md:22px;--r-lg:28px;--r-xl:34px;--r-2xl:42px;--r-full:9999px;

  /* 阴影系统 — impeccable 多层柔和 */
  --shadow-xs:0 1px 2px rgba(28,25,23,.03);
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 3px rgba(28,25,23,.04),0 0 0 1px rgba(28,25,23,.03);
  --shadow-md:0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.05),0 0 0 1px rgba(28,25,23,.03);
  --shadow-lg:0 8px 32px rgba(28,25,23,.07),0 2px 8px rgba(28,25,23,.03);
  --shadow-xl:0 16px 48px rgba(28,25,23,.1),0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.05);
  --shadow-red-glow:0 0 0 3px rgba(181,52,58,.12);
  --shadow-pine-glow:0 0 0 3px rgba(61,107,82,.10);

  /* hnu-tab-essence — 4 Tab 差异化设计令牌 */
  --tab-gate-depth:rgba(28,25,23,.08);
  --tab-gate-eaves:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  --tab-seal-border:rgba(181,52,58,.25);
  --tab-seal-border-hover:rgba(181,52,58,.45);
  --tab-debate-divider:rgba(28,25,23,.08);
  --tab-debate-divider-hover:rgba(28,25,23,.14);
  --tab-ascent-l1:rgba(28,25,23,.03);
  --tab-ascent-l2:rgba(91,125,140,.04);
  --tab-ascent-l3:rgba(181,52,58,.05);

  /* 缓动函数 — apple-design 弹簧物理 */
  --ease-default:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  --ease-bounce:cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  --ease-smooth:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  --ease-snappy:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  --ease-spring:cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1.4);

  --t-fast:150ms;--t-normal:280ms;--t-slow:420ms;--t-breath:4000ms;
  --touch:48px;
  --safe-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,16px);
  --max-width:600px;--nav-h:52px;
}


/* merged reduced-motion - cleaned */
@media(prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce){
  .glass,.glass-nav{background:var(--surface)!important;backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}
}

/* ===== Reset ===== */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{font-size:16px;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Display","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Hiragino Sans GB",sans-serif;
  background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;
  line-height:1.72;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
  overflow-x:hidden;overscroll-behavior-y:none;position:relative;
  transition:background var(--t-slow) var(--ease-default),color var(--t-slow) var(--ease-default);
}
body::before{
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;
  background-image:var(--bg-image);
  background-size:100% auto;background-position:center top;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  opacity:.30;filter:brightness(.97) saturate(.90);
  pointer-events:none;transition:opacity var(--t-slow) var(--ease-default);
}
@media(min-width:768px){
  body::before{
    background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  }
}
/* Phase 4: 岳麓山雾 — 60s 4点路径模拟山雾漂移 */
body::before{animation:hnu-mountain-mist 60s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes hnu-mountain-mist{
  0%{transform:scale(1) translate(0,0)}
  33%{transform:scale(1.006) translate(2px,-1px)}
  66%{transform:scale(1.004) translate(-1px,.5px)}
  100%{transform:scale(1.008) translate(0,-.5px)}
}
/* 御书楼 · 英雄区 0.5%极缓呼吸 */
@keyframes hnu-imperial-presence{
  0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}
  50%{transform:scale(1.004)}
}
::selection{background:var(--red-subtle);color:var(--ink)}

/* ===== 布局 ===== */
.app-shell{max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative}
/* ===== 视图切换与入场编排 ===== */
.view{display:none;flex:1;flex-direction:column;opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);transition:opacity 350ms var(--ease-default),transform 350ms var(--ease-default);will-change:opacity,transform}
.view.active{display:flex;opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
/* UI UX Pro Max: 全站禁用自动入场动画 —— DOM重建时opacity:0→1即闪烁 */
.view.active .ent-1,.view.active .ent-2,.view.active .ent-3,.view.active .ent-4,
.view.active .ent-5,.view.active .ent-6,.view.active .ent-7,.view.active .ent-8{animation:none!important}
/* 四大模块卡片交错拾起 */
/* removed */
/* removed */
/* removed */
/* removed */
/* removed unused */
/* ============================================================
   湖南大学 · 千年学府动效体系
   ─────────────────────────────────
   竹简翻页 · card过渡 — 如翻阅岳麓书院藏古籍竹简
   钤印选定 · option   — 如朱砂印章钤于宣纸，笃定不可悔
   金声玉振 · correct  — 如御书楼铜钟轻震，余韵悠长
   湘江涟漪 · wrong    — 如墨滴入湘江，涟漪过后水静如初
   千年脉动 · ambient  — 如书院千年弦歌不绝，极缓呼吸
   墨韵渐浓 · hover    — 如松烟墨在宣纸上自然晕染
   ============================================================ */

/* --- 竹简翻页 · 切题过渡 --- */
/* 极浅rotateX模拟古籍翻页。quiz-slide类优先级高于.quiz-card，直接覆盖入院动画 */
.quiz-slide-next{animation:hnu-bamboo-next .3s cubic-bezier(.33,0,.67,1) both}
.quiz-slide-prev{animation:hnu-bamboo-prev .3s cubic-bezier(.33,0,.67,1) both}
@keyframes hnu-bamboo-next{
  from{opacity:.55;transform:perspective(1200px) rotateX(3deg);filter:brightness(1.06)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:perspective(1200px) rotateX(0);filter:brightness(1)}
}
@keyframes hnu-bamboo-prev{
  from{opacity:.55;transform:perspective(1200px) rotateX(-3deg);filter:brightness(1.06)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:perspective(1200px) rotateX(0);filter:brightness(1)}
}
/* 数字飞入 - 已禁用 */
.num-pop{display:inline-block}

/* ===== 毛玻璃导航栏 ===== */
.glass-nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:8px 10px;height:var(--nav-h);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.58);backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  transition:background var(--t-normal) var(--ease-default),border-color var(--t-normal) var(--ease-default);
}
.glass-nav-title{font-size:.84rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;flex:1;text-align:center;color:var(--ink)}
.glass-nav-btn{
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:none;
  background:rgba(128,128,128,.08);color:var(--ink-soft);
  cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);flex-shrink:0;
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
}
.glass-nav-btn:hover{background:rgba(128,128,128,.14);color:var(--ink)}
.glass-nav-btn:active{transform:scale(.88);transition:transform .1s var(--ease-snappy)}

/* ===== 通用按钮 ===== */
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  padding:11px 22px;border-radius:var(--r-full);border:none;
  font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;
  cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;outline:none;
}
.btn:focus-visible{box-shadow:var(--shadow-red-glow)}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.btn-primary{
  background:var(--red);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(181,52,58,.25);
}
.btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(181,52,58,.35);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-secondary{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.52);color:var(--ink);
  border:1px solid var(--ink-line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
}
.btn-secondary:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border-color:var(--red-border)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--red-surface);color:var(--red)}
.btn-sm{padding:9px 16px;font-size:.74rem;min-height:42px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}

/* ============================================================
   启动屏 · Splash
   ============================================================ */
.splash{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;
  padding:56px 28px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper) 0%,var(--paper-warm) 35%,var(--red-surface) 60%,rgba(181,52,58,.08) 80%,var(--paper-warm) 100%);
}
.splash::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:-160px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:480px;height:480px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(181,52,58,.05) 0%,rgba(184,147,90,.03) 30%,transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.splash-emblem-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:-20% 0 0 0;z-index:0;opacity:.08;
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  pointer-events:none;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,black 25%,transparent 70%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,black 25%,transparent 70%);
  animation:splashBgIn 1.6s var(--ease-default) both;
}
/* removed unused */
.splash-seal-wrap{
  position:relative;z-index:2;animation:sealEnter 1.1s var(--ease-bounce) both;margin-bottom:32px;
}
.splash-seal-glow{
  position:absolute;inset:-28px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(181,52,58,.14) 0%,rgba(184,147,90,.08) 40%,transparent 70%);
  animation:sealBreathe var(--t-breath) ease-in-out infinite;z-index:0;
}
.splash-seal-ring{
  position:absolute;inset:-18px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1.5px solid var(--red-border);opacity:.5;z-index:0;
  animation:ringRotate 20s linear infinite;
}
.splash-seal-img{
  width:108px;height:108px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:contain;
  position:relative;z-index:1;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 28px rgba(181,52,58,.22));
  animation:sealFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite;
  background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
/* removed unused */
@keyframes sealFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes sealBreathe{0%,100%{opacity:.55;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.9;transform:scale(1.07)}}
/* removed unused */
.splash-stamp{
  position:absolute;bottom:100px;right:28px;
  width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;
  overflow:hidden;opacity:.45;z-index:3;
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(181,52,58,.12);
  animation:stampIn 1s var(--ease-bounce) .35s both;transform:rotate(8deg);
}
.splash-stamp img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
@keyframes stampIn{from{opacity:0;transform:rotate(8deg) scale(.5)}to{opacity:.45;transform:rotate(8deg) scale(1)}}
.splash-title{font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink);position:relative;z-index:2;animation:textUp .75s var(--ease-default) .08s both}
.splash-title mark{background:none;color:var(--red);font-style:normal;animation:textGlow 3s ease-in-out 1s infinite alternate}
@keyframes textGlow{0%{color:var(--red)}100%{color:var(--red-deep)}}
.splash-subtitle{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink-faint);line-height:2.2;position:relative;z-index:2;animation:textUp .75s var(--ease-default) .22s both;margin-bottom:4px}
.splash-subtitle em{font-style:normal;display:block;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:.72rem;margin-top:4px;opacity:.8}
.splash-enter-btn{
  animation:textUp .75s var(--ease-default) .45s both;position:relative;z-index:2;
  padding:14px 52px;border-radius:var(--r-full);border:none;
  background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.05em;cursor:pointer;
  transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
  box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(181,52,58,.28);
}
.splash-enter-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(181,52,58,.45)}
.splash-enter-btn:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.splash-years{font-size:.64rem;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.16em;animation:textUp .75s var(--ease-default) .55s both;opacity:.4;position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:6px}
@keyframes textUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* ============================================================
   首页 · 英雄品牌区
   ============================================================ */
.brand-hero{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:rgba(26,20,22,.55);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(140%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(140%);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  padding:28px 20px 24px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  min-height:200px;
}
/* 底部渐变过渡 */
.brand-hero::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:20px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,var(--paper) 100%);
  pointer-events:none;z-index:2;
}
/* 微光移除 - 毛玻璃不需要 */
.brand-hero::before{display:none}
/* 水印 */
.brand-hero .brand-watermark{
  position:absolute;right:-30px;top:-20px;
  width:180px;height:180px;opacity:.04;
  background-image:var(--emblem-image);
  background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center;
  pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
}

/* 左栏: 校徽 */
.brand-left{
  position:relative;z-index:1;flex-shrink:0;
}
.brand-logo{
  width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:contain;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);padding:5px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.35),0 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  animation:logoBreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes logoBreathe{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.30),0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 8px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.36),0 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
}

/* 中栏: 文字 */
.brand-center{
  flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;
  position:relative;z-index:1;min-width:0;
}
.brand-name{
  font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.95);letter-spacing:.10em;line-height:1.1;
  text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.brand-motto{
  font-size:.66rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);letter-spacing:.10em;font-weight:500;
}
.brand-verse{
  font-size:.60rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:400;
}
.brand-verse+.brand-verse{margin-top:0}
.brand-subtitle{
  font-size:.52rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);letter-spacing:.10em;font-weight:400;
}

/* 右栏: Liquid Glass Tab */
.brand-right{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;
  position:relative;z-index:1;flex-shrink:0;
}
/* Liquid Glass Tab */
.glass-tabs{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;
}
.glass-tab{
  position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;
  border-radius:var(--r-xl);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:all .35s var(--ease-spring);
  -webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
}
.glass-tab::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;border-radius:inherit;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 10%,rgba(255,255,255,.3),transparent 50%),
              linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.1),transparent 40%,rgba(255,255,255,.08));
  pointer-events:none;
}
.glass-tab:hover{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.24),0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.glass-tab:active{transform:scale(.96);transition:transform .1s var(--ease-snappy)}
.glass-tab.active{
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.36),
             0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.12),
             0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,.12),
             0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
/* Tab内图标 */
.glass-tab-icon{
  width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);flex-shrink:0;
}
.glass-tab-icon svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.95)}
.glass-tab.active .glass-tab-icon{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.glass-tab-text{flex:1;min-width:0}
.glass-tab-label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.95);letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1.2;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.glass-tab-code{font-size:.56rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);letter-spacing:.08em;margin-top:1px}
/* 简化tab (备用) */
.brand-tabs-simple{
  display:flex;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1;
}
.brand-tab-simple{
  padding:6px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-full);font-size:.66rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);cursor:pointer;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.brand-tab-simple.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.brand-tab-simple:hover:not(.active){color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}

/* ============================================================
   章节切换区
   ============================================================ */
.chapter-strip{
  padding:10px 16px;background:var(--paper-warm);
  display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-line);-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}
.chapter-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.chapter-chip{
  padding:8px 20px;border-radius:9999px;font-size:.70rem;font-weight:500;
  white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;
  background:rgba(28,25,23,.04);color:var(--ink-soft);border:1px solid rgba(28,25,23,.08);
  transition:all .25s ease;
}
.chapter-chip.active{background:#8B1A2B;color:#FFF;border:1px solid #8B1A2B}
.chapter-chip:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.chapter-chip:hover:not(.active){background:rgba(28,25,23,.08)}

/* ============================================================
   仪表盘
   ============================================================ */
.dashboard{padding:16px 18px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.dash-greeting{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:500}
.dash-ring-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.dash-ring{position:relative;width:72px;height:72px;flex-shrink:0}
.dash-ring svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.dash-ring-pct{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--red);line-height:1.1}
.dash-ring-pct small{font-size:.50rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.04em}
.dash-info{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.6}
.dash-info strong{color:var(--red);font-weight:700}
.dash-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;width:100%;padding:0 2px 4px}
.dash-stat{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.48);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:14px 6px;text-align:center;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);border:1px solid var(--ink-line);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  transition:transform .35s var(--ease-spring),box-shadow .35s var(--ease-default),border-color .25s var(--ease-smooth);
}
.dash-stat:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border-color:var(--red-border)}
.dash-stat-val{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--red);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.dash-stat-val.accent{color:var(--pine)}
.dash-stat-val.warn{color:#C06050}
.dash-stat-lbl{font-size:.60rem;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:500}

/* ============================================================
   首页功能入口 · 2×2 网格 · hnu-tab-essence 四建筑差异化设计
   意象映射：书院开门 / 朱砂钤印 / 朱张会讲 / 自卑登高
   ============================================================ */
.module-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:0 2px 18px;margin-top:18px}

/* ——— 共享基底：毛玻璃 + 触控热区 ——— */
.module-grid [data-action]{
  cursor:pointer;position:relative;
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  min-height:var(--touch);
}
.module-grid [data-action]:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--red-glow)}
.module-grid [data-action]:active{transform:scale(.97);transition:transform .1s var(--ease-smooth)}

/* ============================================================
   Tab 1: 全部刷题 — 书院开门 .tab-gate
   意象：岳麓书院头门·三开间硬山顶·推门而入千年学海
   规格：纵向门殿立面 / 顶边飞檐光边 / 内阴影门洞深度
   ============================================================ */
.tab-gate{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:16px 12px 14px;gap:6px;
  border-radius:var(--r-md) var(--r-md) var(--r-sm) var(--r-sm);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.48);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.30);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 var(--tab-gate-eaves),
    inset 0 -4px 12px var(--tab-gate-depth),
    0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.06);
  transition:
    background 300ms var(--ease-smooth),
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-smooth),
    box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-smooth);
}
.tab-gate:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.60);
  border-color:rgba(181,52,58,.18);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65),
    inset 0 -6px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.10),
    0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.06);
}
.tab-gate:active{
  transform:scale(.97);
  transition:transform 350ms var(--ease-spring);
}
/* 飞檐光边 — 顶边晨光被屋檐切割 */
.gate-eaves{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:12px;right:12px;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.7) 20%,rgba(255,255,255,.9) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.7) 80%,transparent 100%);
  border-radius:0 0 1px 1px;
  opacity:.35;transition:opacity 400ms var(--ease-smooth);
}
.tab-gate:hover .gate-eaves{opacity:.65}
/* 门洞内容 */
.gate-emblem{width:36px;height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--red);background:rgba(181,52,58,.08);border-radius:var(--r-xs)}
.gate-emblem svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.gate-title{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.04em}
.gate-sub{font-size:.56rem;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.55}

/* ============================================================
   Tab 2: 选择专项 — 朱砂钤印 .tab-seal
   意象：讲堂"实事求是"匾·落笔无悔·钤印为证
   规格：正方形印章 / 朱砂描边 / 外圈装饰线 / 居中构图
   ============================================================ */
.tab-seal{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:14px 10px;gap:4px;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.58);
  border:1.5px solid var(--tab-seal-border);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.04);
  transition:
    background 400ms var(--hnu-ease-seal),
    border-color 400ms var(--hnu-ease-seal),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--hnu-ease-seal),
    transform 280ms var(--hnu-ease-seal);
}
.tab-seal:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.68);
  border-color:var(--tab-seal-border-hover);
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(28,25,23,.06);
}
.tab-seal:active{
  transform:scale(.94);
  transition:transform 280ms var(--hnu-ease-seal);
}
/* 印章外圈虚线装饰 */
.seal-ring{
  position:absolute;inset:6px;border-radius:var(--r-xs);
  outline:1px dashed rgba(181,52,58,.10);outline-offset:-1px;
  pointer-events:none;
  transition:outline-color 400ms var(--hnu-ease-seal);
}
.tab-seal:hover .seal-ring{outline-color:rgba(181,52,58,.22)}
/* 印章内核 */
.seal-core{
  position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;
}
.seal-icon{width:33px;height:33px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--red);background:rgba(181,52,58,.07);border-radius:var(--r-xs)}
.seal-icon svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.seal-title{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--red-deep);letter-spacing:.06em}
/* 印文 */
.seal-stamp{
  position:relative;z-index:1;font-family:KaiTi,STKaiti,serif;
  font-size:.54rem;color:var(--red);opacity:0;letter-spacing:.12em;
  transition:opacity 300ms var(--hnu-ease-seal) 100ms;
}
.tab-seal:active .seal-stamp{opacity:.55}

/* ============================================================
   Tab 3: 判断专项 — 朱张会讲 .tab-debate
   意象：1167年张栻与朱熹讲堂论学三日三夜·辩而后定
   规格：横向双栏对开 / 中线分隔 / 左右"是""非"铭文
   ============================================================ */
.tab-debate{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.05);
  padding:0;overflow:hidden;
  transition:
    background 300ms var(--ease-smooth),
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-smooth),
    box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-smooth);
}
.tab-debate:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.58);
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.40);
}
.tab-debate:active{
  transform:scale(.97);
  transition:transform 200ms var(--hnu-ease-debate);
}
/* 辩论双栏容器 */
.debate-row{display:flex;flex:1;align-items:stretch}
.debate-left, .debate-right{
  flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  min-height:54px;position:relative;
  transition:background 300ms var(--ease-smooth);
}
.debate-left{background:rgba(61,107,82,.025)}
.debate-right{background:rgba(181,52,58,.025)}
.tab-debate:hover .debate-left{background:rgba(61,107,82,.05)}
.tab-debate:hover .debate-right{background:rgba(181,52,58,.05)}
/* 中线 — 论辩分隔 */
.debate-divider{
  width:1px;align-self:stretch;
  background:var(--tab-debate-divider);
  transition:background 400ms var(--ease-smooth),width 400ms var(--ease-smooth);
}
.tab-debate:hover .debate-divider{background:var(--tab-debate-divider-hover)}
/* 是/非铭文 */
.debate-mark-t, .debate-mark-f{
  font-family:KaiTi,STKaiti,serif;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.08em;transition:all 300ms var(--ease-smooth);
}
.debate-mark-t{color:var(--pine);opacity:.55}
.debate-mark-f{color:var(--red);opacity:.55}
.tab-debate:hover .debate-mark-t{opacity:.78;transform:translateX(-1px)}
.tab-debate:hover .debate-mark-f{opacity:.78;transform:translateX(1px)}
/* 标题 */
.debate-title-row{text-align:center;padding:8px 8px 10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(28,25,23,.04)}
.debate-label{font-size:.74rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.06em}

/* ============================================================
   Tab 4: 错题集 — 自卑登高 .tab-ascent
   意象：自卑亭→道中庸亭→极高明亭·登高必自卑·行远必自迩
   规格：三层递进堆叠背景 / 从暗到亮 / 错题数动态
   ============================================================ */
.tab-ascent{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:14px 10px;gap:4px;
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.05);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:
    background 300ms var(--ease-default),
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-default),
    box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-default);
}
.tab-ascent:hover{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.56);
  border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);
}
.tab-ascent:active{
  transform:scale(.97);
  transition:transform 200ms var(--ease-default);
}
/* 三层递进背景 — 自卑→中庸→高明 */
.ascent-l1, .ascent-l2, .ascent-l3{
  position:absolute;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;
  transition:background 400ms var(--ease-smooth);
}
.ascent-l1{
  inset:4px;border-radius:calc(var(--r-md) - 2px);
  background:var(--tab-ascent-l1);
  transition-delay:0ms;
}
.ascent-l2{
  inset:10px;border-radius:calc(var(--r-md) - 6px);
  background:var(--tab-ascent-l2);
  transition-delay:60ms;
}
.ascent-l3{
  inset:16px;border-radius:calc(var(--r-md) - 10px);
  background:var(--tab-ascent-l3);
  transition-delay:120ms;
}
.tab-ascent:hover .ascent-l1{background:rgba(28,25,23,.05)}
.tab-ascent:hover .ascent-l2{background:rgba(91,125,140,.07)}
.tab-ascent:hover .ascent-l3{background:rgba(181,52,58,.09)}
/* 内容层 */
.ascent-content{
  position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;
}
.ascent-icon{width:32px;height:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  color:var(--water);background:rgba(91,125,140,.06);border-radius:var(--r-xs)}
.ascent-icon svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.ascent-title{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.04em}
.ascent-count{
  font-size:.56rem;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.65;
  animation:ascent-count-breathe 8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ascent-count-breathe{
  0%,100%{opacity:.5}
  50%{opacity:.85}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .ascent-count{animation:none;opacity:.65}
}

/* ============================================================
   页脚 · 灵魂文案
   ============================================================ */
.home-footer-old{text-align:center;padding:8px 20px 20px;font-size:.64rem;color:#9C9590;opacity:.45;letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:2}
.home-footer .motto-strong{display:block;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:600;opacity:.7}
.home-footer .motto-sword{font-size:.58rem;opacity:.5;letter-spacing:.16em}

/* ============================================================
   HNU Academy: 首页交互 — 纯transition，无keyframe动画
   ============================================================ */



/* ============================================================
   刷题视图
   ============================================================ */
/* UI UX Pro Max: 导航栏玻璃态 opacity 0.35（中位值0.25-0.45），border 0.15可见边 */
.quiz-topbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 14px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);z-index:50;
}
/* 点阵进度——每道题一个圆点，状态三态映射(已对/已错/当前/未答) */
.quiz-progress-wrap{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.quiz-progress-dots{flex:1;display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.quiz-progress-dots::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.quiz-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(28,25,23,.10);transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth)}
.quiz-dot.done{background:var(--pine);border-radius:50%}
.quiz-dot.wrong-dot{background:#C06050;border-radius:2px}
.quiz-dot.active{background:var(--red);width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;animation:hnu-breathe 8s ease-in-out infinite}
.quiz-progress-num{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.swipe-hint{text-align:center;font-size:.62rem;color:var(--ink-faint);padding:6px 0;opacity:.4;letter-spacing:.06em}
/* UI UX Pro Max: 续练Toast — 从底部优雅滑入，4s自动消失，非突兀横幅 */
.resume-banner{
  position:fixed;bottom:calc(40px + var(--safe-bottom));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  z-index:300;max-width:calc(100% - 32px);width:fit-content;white-space:nowrap;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  padding:13px 20px;border-radius:var(--r-full);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(180%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(28px) saturate(180%);
  color:var(--ink);font-size:.76rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;
  box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(28,25,23,.10),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.40);
  animation:quiz-toast-in .5s var(--ease-spring) both,quiz-toast-out .4s var(--ease-smooth) 3.5s forwards;
  pointer-events:auto;
}
@keyframes quiz-toast-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);filter:blur(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);filter:blur(0)}}
@keyframes quiz-toast-out{from{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}to{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(12px);pointer-events:none}}
.resume-banner::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:20px;right:20px;height:1.5px;
  background:rgba(28,25,23,.10);border-radius:1px;
  animation:quiz-toast-bar 3.2s linear .2s forwards;
}
@keyframes quiz-toast-bar{from{transform:scaleX(1)}to{transform:scaleX(0)}}
.resume-restart{
  margin-left:0;font-size:.66rem;color:var(--ink-faint);
  cursor:pointer;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em;
  opacity:.7;transition:all var(--t-fast);
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.resume-restart:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--red)}
/* taste-skills: 满屏填充——填满topbar以下到安全区的全部高度，禁止"顶部堆砌下方留空" */
/* impeccable: 卡片flex:1纵向填充+选项space-evenly均匀分布 */
.quiz-card-wrap{flex:1;padding:10px 16px calc(10px + var(--safe-bottom));display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
/* UI UX Pro Max Glassmorphism #3: 卡片opacity 0.30（中位值0.25-0.45），border 0.20可见玻璃边 */
/* 原0.10被skill标记为反模式——浅色模式下过于透明 */
.quiz-card{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:rgba(255,255,255,.50);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:20px 18px;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(28,25,23,.04),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.20),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:1px solid var(--ink-line)}
.q-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px}
.q-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:var(--r-full);font-size:.60rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.q-tag-num{background:rgba(181,52,58,.08);color:var(--red)}
.q-tag-type{background:rgba(91,125,140,.06);color:var(--water)}
.q-tag-diff{background:rgba(184,147,90,.06);color:var(--gold)}
.q-tag-topic{background:rgba(28,25,23,.03);color:var(--ink-soft)}
/* taste-skills: 题目分段——长题拆分背景描述(细)与核心提问(粗)增加纵向占位 */
.q-stem{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.02em;padding:2px 0}
.q-stem-line1{font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:2px 0 6px}
.q-stem-line2{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:2px 0}
.q-stem img,.q-stem-line1 img,.q-stem-line2 img{max-width:100%;border-radius:var(--r-sm);cursor:zoom-in}
/* frontend-design: 剑指湖大四色系统——色相锁定现有变量，不引入新色相 */
/* impeccable: 四色透明度统一(边框20%+字母背景10%)+圆角方块14px+min-height:52px */
.opt-jian{--_oc:var(--red);--_os:var(--red-subtle);--_og:var(--red-glow)}
.opt-zhi{--_oc:var(--pine);--_os:var(--pine-subtle);--_og:var(--pine-glow)}
.opt-hu{--_oc:var(--gold);--_os:var(--gold-subtle);--_og:var(--gold-subtle)}
.opt-da{--_oc:var(--blue);--_os:var(--blue-subtle);--_og:var(--blue-glow)}

/* taste-skills: 选项紧凑排列+卡片flex:1自然撑满剩余空间 */
.options-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.option{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 16px;min-height:44px;
  border-radius:var(--r-md);background:rgba(255,255,255,.40);border:1.5px solid var(--ink-line);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
}
.opt-jian,.opt-zhi,.opt-hu,.opt-da{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--_oc) 20%,transparent)}
.option:hover{border-color:var(--_oc);background:var(--_os)}
.option.selected{border-color:var(--_oc);background:var(--_os);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--_og)}
.option.selected .option-letter{background:var(--_oc);color:#fff}
.option.locked{cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.option.correct{border-color:var(--pine)!important;background:var(--pine-subtle);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--pine-glow)}
.option.wrong{border-color:#C06050!important;background:rgba(192,96,80,.06)}
/* UI UX Pro Max A11y #1-2: 键盘焦点可见 + 44px触控 */
.option:focus-visible,.tf-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:var(--r-md)}
.bm-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:50%}
/* UI UX Pro Max A11y #5: reduced-motion 尊重 */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .option:active,.tf-btn:active,.quiz-actions .btn:active,.bm-btn:active{transform:none!important;transition:none!important}
}
/* impeccable: 字母方块28×28px+圆角14px(非圆形)+字重800 */
.option-letter{
  width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:.80rem;font-weight:800;background:var(--_os);color:var(--_oc);
  flex-shrink:0;transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.option:hover .option-letter{background:var(--_oc);color:#fff}
.option.correct .option-letter{background:var(--pine);color:#fff}
.option.wrong .option-letter{background:#C06050;color:#fff}
.option-text{font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink);flex:1}

/* ============================================================
   湖南大学 · 千年学府交互动效体系
   ─────────────────────────────────
   竹简翻页 · card过渡 — rotateX(3deg) 如翻阅古籍竹简
   钤印选定 · option   — 先沉后稳，如朱砂印章钤于宣纸
   金声玉振 · correct  — 径向光晕扩散，如御书楼铜钟余韵
   墨滴入潭 · wrong    — 微微下沉后平静，如松烟墨滴落湘江
   千年脉动 · ambient  — 8s极缓呼吸，书院千年弦歌不绝
   墨韵渐染 · hover    — 色相渐深，如墨在宣纸上自然晕开
   ─────────────────────────────────
   Skills: apple-design(弹簧物理) + ui-ux-pro-max(玻璃态)
           taste-skill(反AI跳脱) + impeccable(帧级)
           redesign-skill(移除自动动画)
   ============================================================ */

/* --- 竹简翻页 · 切题过渡 （已在 quiz-slide 实现）--- */

/* --- 钤印选定 · 选项按压 --- */
/* 模拟印章按压：沉 → 微弹 → 落定。不跳不浮，笃定有力 */
.option:active{transform:scale(.97);transition:transform .1s cubic-bezier(.33,0,.67,1)}

/* --- 钤印落定 · 选中状态 --- */
/* 字母方块实色填充 + 外圈阴影如印泥渗出 */
.option.selected{border-color:var(--_oc);background:var(--_os);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--_og),0 0 0 4px var(--_og);transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.33,0,.67,1)}
.option.selected .option-letter{background:var(--_oc);color:#fff;transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.33,0,.67,1)}

/* --- 金声玉振 · 答对 --- */
/* 松绿光晕从选项中心向外扩散，如铜钟被敲响后的余韵 */
@keyframes hnu-bell{
  0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(61,107,82,.25),inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(61,107,82,.06)}
  25%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(61,107,82,0),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(61,107,82,.12)}
  100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(61,107,82,0),inset 0 0 0 0 rgba(61,107,82,0)}
}
.option.correct{
  border-color:var(--pine)!important;background:var(--pine-subtle);
  animation:hnu-bell 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) both;
}

/* --- 墨滴入潭 · 答错 --- */
/* 选项微微下沉后恢复，如一滴松烟墨落入湘江 */
@keyframes hnu-ink-drop{
  0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}
  40%{transform:translateY(2px);opacity:.92}
  100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}
}
.option.wrong{
  border-color:#C06050!important;background:rgba(192,96,80,.04);
  animation:hnu-ink-drop .55s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) both;
}
.option.wrong .option-letter{background:#C06050;color:#fff}

/* --- 墨韵渐染 · hover --- */
/* 边框色徐徐加深，如墨在宣纸上缓缓晕开 */
.option{transition:border-color .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),background .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.option:hover{border-color:var(--_oc);background:var(--_os);transition-duration:.25s}
.option:hover .option-letter{background:var(--_oc);color:#fff;transition:all .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}

/* --- 千年脉动 · hnu-breathe keyframe（.quiz-dot.active 引用）--- */
@keyframes hnu-breathe{0%,100%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.12)}}

/* --- 解析渐入 --- */
@keyframes hnu-unfold{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(3px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
}
.explanation{animation:hnu-unfold .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) both;overflow:hidden}

/* --- 收藏 · 朱砂记 --- */
.bm-btn svg{transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.bm-btn:active svg{transform:scale(1.12)}
.bm-btn.active{color:var(--gold)}

/* --- 按钮 · 墨韵轻触 --- */
.quiz-actions .btn:active{transform:scale(.97);transition:transform .1s cubic-bezier(.33,0,.67,1)}

/* --- 千年学府 · 校徽呼吸 --- */
.brand-logo{animation:logoBreathe 8s ease-in-out infinite}

/* ============================================================
   Phase 2: 答题页交互覆盖
   ─────────────────────────────────
   hnu-seal-press   · 标签钤印 — q-tag交错stamp-in
   hnu-bamboo-unroll · 题干竹简展开 — clip-path从底揭示
   hnu-debate-strike · TF选定 — 辩论中落定立场
   hnu-progress-pulse · 进度梯度 — 自卑→赫曦台 + 微闪
   hnu-eaves-light  · 卡片光边 — 粉墙黛瓦檐口反光
   ============================================================ */

/* --- 标签钤印 --- */
@keyframes hnu-seal-press{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6) translateY(-4px)}
  55%{transform:scale(1.08) translateY(0)}
  100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}
}
.q-tag{animation:hnu-seal-press .4s var(--ease-spring) both}
.q-tag:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.02s}
.q-tag:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.07s}
.q-tag:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.12s}
.q-tag:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.17s}

/* --- 题干竹简展开 --- */
@keyframes hnu-bamboo-unroll{
  from{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0)}
  to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}
}
.q-stem,.q-stem-line1,.q-stem-line2{animation:hnu-bamboo-unroll .35s var(--ease-default) both}

/* --- TF辩论落定 --- */
@keyframes hnu-debate-strike{
  0%{transform:scale(1)}
  30%{transform:scale(.94)}
  55%{transform:scale(1.03)}
  100%{transform:scale(1)}
}
.tf-btn.selected-t,.tf-btn.selected-f{animation:hnu-debate-strike .35s var(--ease-spring) both}

/* --- 进度梯度脉冲 --- */
/* 自卑亭(水色)→赫曦台(红色) + 每步微闪 */
.quiz-progress-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--water) 0%,var(--red) 100%)}
@keyframes hnu-step-glow{0%,100%{filter:brightness(1)}50%{filter:brightness(1.25)}}

/* --- 卡片檐口光边 --- */
.quiz-card::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:8px;right:8px;height:1px;z-index:1;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.25),transparent);
  opacity:.04;border-radius:1px;pointer-events:none;
  animation:hnu-eaves-light 8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes hnu-eaves-light{0%,100%{opacity:.04}50%{opacity:.10}}

/* --- 答题按钮交互收敛 --- */
.quiz-actions .btn{transition:color .2s var(--ease-smooth),background .2s var(--ease-smooth)}
.quiz-actions .btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.quiz-actions .btn:active{transform:scale(.97);transition:transform .1s cubic-bezier(.33,0,.67,1)}

/* --- Reduced Motion · 归于静止 --- */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .quiz-slide-next,.quiz-slide-prev,.option.wrong,.option.correct,
  .explanation,.quiz-dot.active,.q-tag,.q-stem,.q-stem-line1,.q-stem-line2,
  .tf-btn.selected-t,.tf-btn.selected-f,.quiz-card::after,
  .option:active,.quiz-actions .btn:active,.bm-btn:active,
  .brand-logo{animation:none!important;transform:none!important;transition:none!important;clip-path:none!important}
}

.tf-row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:10px}
/* frontend-design: 判断题 剑(红)=正确 / 指(绿)=错误 */
.tf-btn{
  flex:1;padding:18px 16px;min-height:56px;border-radius:var(--r-md);text-align:center;
  font-size:.90rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;
  cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
  border:2px solid var(--ink-line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.40);color:var(--ink-soft);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
/* 左=剑=正确: 红边框hover */
.tf-btn:first-child:hover:not(.locked){border-color:var(--red);background:var(--red-subtle);color:var(--red)}
/* 右=指=错误: 绿边框hover */
.tf-btn:last-child:hover:not(.locked){border-color:var(--pine);background:var(--pine-subtle);color:var(--pine)}
.tf-btn:active:not(.locked){transform:scale(.96);transition:transform .1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.tf-btn.locked{cursor:default;pointer-events:none}
.tf-btn.selected-t{border-color:var(--red);background:var(--red-subtle);color:var(--red);border-width:2px}
.tf-btn.selected-f{border-color:var(--pine);background:var(--pine-subtle);color:var(--pine);border-width:2px}
.tf-btn.correct{border-color:var(--pine);background:var(--pine-subtle);color:var(--pine);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--pine-glow)}
.tf-btn.wrong{border-color:#C06050;background:rgba(192,96,80,.06);color:#C06050}
.explanation{
  margin-top:14px;padding:14px;border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.42);border:1px solid rgba(28,25,23,.06);
  backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  animation:explIn var(--t-normal) var(--ease-default) both;
}
@keyframes explIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.explanation-label{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:6px}
.explanation p,.explanation{font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft)}
/* taste-skills: 导航在卡片内部底部，与选项区融为一体 */
/* impeccable: 分隔线+按钮紧凑排列+44px触控区 */
/* UI UX Pro Max + taste-skill + impeccable: 导航悬浮玻璃胶囊，在卡片底部居中 */
.quiz-actions{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  padding:8px 8px;margin:12px auto 0;width:fit-content;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);
  border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  box-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(28,25,23,.04),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18);
}
.quiz-actions .spacer{width:12px}
/* 导航按钮 - 胶囊内透明文字 */
.quiz-actions .btn{
  min-height:38px;min-width:38px;padding:6px 14px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:transparent;border:none;box-shadow:none;border-radius:9999px;
  color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:500;font-size:.74rem;
  transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.quiz-actions .btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:var(--ink)}
.quiz-actions .btn:active{transform:scale(.94);transition:transform .1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.quiz-actions .btn:disabled{opacity:.25;pointer-events:none}
/* 收藏星标 */
.quiz-actions .bm-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-faint);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);flex-shrink:0}
.quiz-actions .bm-btn:hover{color:var(--gold);background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.quiz-actions .bm-btn.active{color:var(--gold)}
.quiz-actions .bm-btn:active{transform:scale(.85);transition:transform .1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.quiz-actions .bm-btn svg{transition:transform .45s var(--ease-spring)}
.quiz-actions .bm-btn:active svg{transform:scale(1.35) rotate(22deg)}

/* ============================================================
   答题页 · 英雄区延伸（简化版）
   taste-skills: 复用首页hero-card视觉语言，东方书卷气
   impeccable: 像素级圆角统一+校徽呼吸光晕
   emilkowalski: 毛玻璃遮罩+弹簧缓动
   ============================================================ */
.quiz-hero{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  margin:10px 14px 0;min-height:170px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:20px 16px;
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;
}
.quiz-hero::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(26,20,22,.65) 0%,rgba(107,29,43,.55) 100%);
  border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;
}
/* 底部渐变过渡——从透明自然融入背景 */
.quiz-hero::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:18px;z-index:2;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,rgba(249,246,240,.06) 100%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.quiz-hero-logo{
  width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:contain;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);padding:4px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.32),0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1;
  animation:logoBreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.quiz-hero-info{
  flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;
  position:relative;z-index:1;min-width:0;
}
.quiz-hero-name{
  font-size:1rem;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  letter-spacing:.10em;line-height:1.15;
  text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.quiz-hero-motto{
  font-size:.66rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.50);letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:500;
}
.quiz-hero-verse{
  font-size:.58rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:400;font-style:italic;
}

/* ============================================================
   结果页
   ============================================================ */
.result-view{padding:28px 18px calc(24px + var(--safe-bottom));text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.result-ring-wrap{position:relative;width:160px;height:160px;margin:0 auto 24px}
.result-ring-wrap svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.result-score{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.result-score-num{font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--red);letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1}
.result-score-sub{font-size:.64rem;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-top:2px}
/* Phase 5: 赫曦台 — 成绩如日出，brightness从耀到稳 */
.result-grade{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:6px;animation:hnu-sunrise .9s var(--ease-spring) .3s both}
@keyframes hnu-sunrise{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.88);filter:brightness(1.6) blur(3px)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);filter:brightness(1) blur(0)}}
.result-comment{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.6;animation:textUp .6s var(--ease-default) .5s both}
/* 诗句逐行写出 — 如毛笔运锋 */
.result-poem p{overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;animation:hnu-calligraphy-reveal .8s var(--ease-default) .6s both}
@keyframes hnu-calligraphy-reveal{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}
.result-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;width:100%;max-width:320px;margin-bottom:20px}
.result-stat{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:14px 8px;border:1px solid var(--ink-line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.result-stat-val{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--red)}
.result-stat-val.good{color:var(--pine)}
.result-stat-val.bad{color:#C06050}
.result-stat-lbl{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-top:2px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.result-poem{
  margin:16px 0 20px;padding:16px 24px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);
  background:var(--red-surface);border-radius:0 var(--r-sm) var(--r-sm) 0;
}
.result-poem p{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:2;font-style:italic}
.result-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;width:100%;max-width:280px}

/* ============================================================
   统一列表视图 (错题本/名词本/练习记录/搜索)
   ============================================================ */
.list-page{padding:0 0 calc(20px + var(--safe-bottom))}
.list-header{padding:20px 18px 16px;text-align:center}
.list-header h2{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink)}
.list-header p{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:.04em}
/* 列表全局操作条 */
.list-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:0 16px 12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
/* 统一空状态 */
.empty-state{
  text-align:center;padding:56px 20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  animation:itemEnter .5s var(--ease-default) both;
}
/* Phase 6: 空庭拂晓 — 空状态图标漂浮 */
.empty-state svg{width:48px;height:48px;color:var(--ink-faint);opacity:.35;animation:hnu-courtyard-empty 5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes hnu-courtyard-empty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
/* 错题项 — 检视而非责备，gold左竖条 */
.list-item{transition:all .3s var(--ease-smooth),transform .3s var(--ease-spring)}
.list-item:hover{transform:translateX(4px) scale(1.01);border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
/* 术语卡片 — 御书楼探卷 */
.term-card{transition:all .3s var(--ease-smooth),transform .3s var(--ease-spring)}
.term-card:hover{transform:translateX(3px);border-left:3px solid var(--gold-border)}
.empty-state h3{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);letter-spacing:.04em}
.empty-state p{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.04em;max-width:240px}
/* 筛选标签 */
.filter-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 16px 10px;scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.filter-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.filter-tab{
  padding:6px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-full);font-size:.68rem;font-weight:500;
  white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink-soft);
  cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--ink-line);transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
/* Phase 6: 书院藏书 — 从书架取书 */
@keyframes hnu-pull-volume{0%{transform:scale(1)}30%{transform:scale(.92) translateY(2px)}60%{transform:scale(1.04) translateY(-1px)}100%{transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}}
.filter-tab.active{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red);animation:hnu-pull-volume .4s var(--ease-spring) both}
.filter-tab:active{transform:scale(.94)}
/* 统一列表项 */
.list-item{
  margin:4px 16px;padding:14px 16px;
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  border:1px solid var(--ink-line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.list-item:hover{border-color:var(--red-border);background:var(--red-surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.list-item:active{background:var(--red-subtle);transform:scale(.99)}
.list-item-title{
  font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:4px;
  display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;
}
.list-item-meta{display:flex;gap:12px;font-size:.64rem;color:var(--ink-faint);align-items:center}
.list-item-tag{
  display:inline-flex;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:var(--r-full);
  font-size:.6rem;font-weight:600;
  background:var(--red-surface);color:var(--red);
}
/* 术语卡片(保留独立样式) */
.term-card{
  margin:4px 16px;padding:16px 18px;background:var(--surface);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);border:1px solid var(--ink-line);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs);transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.term-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-border)}
.term-name{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:6px}
.term-def{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.7}


/* ============================================================
   浮层
   ============================================================ */
.sheet-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  backdrop-filter:blur(4px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity var(--t-normal) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.sheet-overlay.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.answer-sheet{
  position:fixed;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(100%);
  width:100%;max-width:var(--max-width);max-height:70vh;
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl) 0 0;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl);z-index:201;overflow-y:auto;
  /* Phase 5: 层层递进 · 过门而入 */
  transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1.4);
}
.answer-sheet.open{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.sheet-handle{width:36px;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--ink-line);margin:10px auto 6px}
.sheet-title{text-align:center;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:6px 0 12px;color:var(--ink)}
.sheet-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:6px;padding:0 16px 20px}
.sheet-num{
  aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-radius:var(--r-xs);font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;
  background:var(--red-surface);color:var(--ink-soft);
  cursor:pointer;transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.sheet-num.current{border:2px solid var(--red);color:var(--red)}
.sheet-num.correct-ans{background:var(--pine-subtle);color:var(--pine)}
.sheet-num.wrong-ans{background:rgba(192,96,80,.08);color:#C06050}

/* ============================================================
   Toast / 成就 / 粒子
   ============================================================ */
.toast{
  position:fixed;bottom:100px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  padding:10px 24px;border-radius:var(--r-full);
  background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-size:.76rem;
  font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;z-index:500;pointer-events:none;
  animation:toastIn .35s var(--ease-bounce),toastOut .3s var(--ease-smooth) 1.8s forwards;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
}
@keyframes toastIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}}
@keyframes toastOut{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:0}}
.achievement-toast{
  position:fixed;top:80px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  padding:14px 22px;border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl);
  border:1px solid var(--gold-border);z-index:500;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-16px);
  transition:all var(--t-normal) var(--ease-bounce);pointer-events:none;
}
.achievement-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);animation:achCelebrate .6s var(--ease-spring) .1s both}
@keyframes achCelebrate{0%{box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(184,147,90,.35),var(--shadow-xl)}100%{box-shadow:var(--shadow-xl)}}
.achievement-toast-text{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.04em}
.achievement-toast-sub{font-size:.66rem;color:var(--ink-faint)}
.achievement-strip{
  display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:12px 16px 4px;
  scrollbar-width:none;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
}
.achievement-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.achievement-badge{
  flex-shrink:0;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-full);
  font-size:.64rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;
  background:var(--mist-subtle);color:var(--ink-faint);
  border:1px solid var(--ink-line);white-space:nowrap;
}
.achievement-badge.unlocked{background:var(--gold-subtle);color:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold-border)}
.particle-container{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:400;pointer-events:none}
.particle{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;animation:particleBurst .8s var(--ease-smooth) forwards}
@keyframes particleBurst{0%{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--px),var(--py)) scale(0)}}
.ripple{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(181,52,58,.15);animation:rippleOut .5s ease-out forwards;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes rippleOut{from{transform:scale(0);opacity:.6}to{transform:scale(3);opacity:0}}
.image-viewer{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:500;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity var(--t-normal) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.image-viewer.open{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.image-viewer img{max-width:92vw;max-height:88vh;object-fit:contain;border-radius:var(--r-sm)}
.image-viewer-close{
  position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;
  border:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;font-size:1.5rem;
  cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:background var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth);
}
.image-viewer-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}

/* ===== Safari兼容 ===== */
@supports(-webkit-touch-callout:none){
  .glass-nav,.quiz-topbar,.quiz-card,.quiz-actions{
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(160%);
  }
}



/* ============================================================
   NEW DESIGN: Splash & Home by taste-skill + impeccable
   ============================================================ */

/* ===== 页面背景层 ===== */
/* 6.3英寸iPhone壁纸适配: 原生比例完整呈现，不裁切不拉伸 */
body::before{
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;
  background-image:var(--bg-image);
  background-size:100% auto;background-position:center top;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  opacity:.30;filter:brightness(.97) saturate(.90);
  animation:hnu-mountain-mist 60s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  pointer-events:none;
}
/* 大屏设备背景回退为cover，保证填充 */
@media(min-width:768px){
  body::before{
    background-size:cover;background-position:center;
  }
}

/* ===== 新版 Splash ===== */
.splash{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;padding:56px 28px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper) 0%,var(--paper-warm) 35%,var(--red-surface) 60%,rgba(181,52,58,.08) 80%,var(--paper-warm) 100%)}
.splash::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-160px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:480px;height:480px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(181,52,58,.05) 0%,rgba(184,147,90,.03) 30%,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.splash-bg-emblem{position:absolute;inset:-20% 0 0 0;z-index:0;opacity:.07;background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;pointer-events:none;-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,black 25%,transparent 70%);mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,black 25%,transparent 70%)}
.seal-stage{position:relative;z-index:2;margin-bottom:32px}
.seal-glow{position:absolute;inset:-28px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(181,52,58,.14) 0%,rgba(184,147,90,.08) 40%,transparent 70%);animation:sealBreathe 5s ease-in-out infinite;z-index:0}
.seal-ring{position:absolute;inset:-18px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--red-border);opacity:.5;z-index:0;animation:ringSpin 20s linear infinite}
.seal-img{width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:contain;position:relative;z-index:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);padding:2px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 0 1px 5px rgba(255,255,255,.04);animation:sealFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sealFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes sealBreathe{0%,100%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.85;transform:scale(1.06)}}
@keyframes ringSpin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.splash-stamp{position:absolute;bottom:100px;right:28px;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;opacity:.4;z-index:3;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(181,52,58,.12);transform:rotate(8deg)}
.splash-stamp img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.splash-title{font-size:1.28rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink);position:relative;z-index:2}
.splash-title mark{background:none;color:var(--red)}
.splash-subtitle{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink-faint);line-height:2.2;position:relative;z-index:2;margin-bottom:4px}
.splash-subtitle em{font-style:normal;display:block;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.68rem;margin-top:4px;opacity:.8}
.splash-enter-btn{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:13px 48px;border-radius:var(--r-full);border:none;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(181,52,58,.28);transition:all var(--t-fast) var(--ease-smooth)}
.splash-enter-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(181,52,58,.45)}
.splash-enter-btn:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.splash-years{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.16em;opacity:.35;position:relative;z-index:2;margin-top:6px;padding-bottom:var(--safe-bottom)}

/* ===== 新版 Home ===== */
/* 防闪：极透白底遮DOM重建间隙，0.12透明度不挡背景图穿透 */
.home-wrap{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding:10px;padding-bottom:calc(24px + var(--safe-bottom))}
.home-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.64) 0%,rgba(249,246,240,.66) 45%,rgba(243,237,228,.68) 100%);backdrop-filter:blur(32px) saturate(170%);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(32px) saturate(170%);border-radius:var(--r-xl);box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(28,25,23,.06),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);padding:18px 14px 20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.home-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:64px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;border-radius:0 0 var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl);background:linear-gradient(175deg,transparent 38%,rgba(181,52,58,.025) 39%,rgba(181,52,58,.04) 52%,transparent 53%),linear-gradient(185deg,transparent 48%,rgba(139,26,43,.025) 49%,rgba(139,26,43,.04) 62%,transparent 63%),linear-gradient(190deg,transparent 58%,rgba(28,25,23,.025) 59%,rgba(28,25,23,.03) 70%,transparent 71%)}
.page-sub{text-align:center;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink-faint);letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:14px}

/* Hero */
.brand-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--r-lg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.brand-hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(26,20,22,.65) 0%,rgba(107,29,43,.55) 100%);border-radius:inherit}
.brand-hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:20px;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,var(--paper) 100%);pointer-events:none}
.brand-watermark{position:absolute;right:-30px;top:-20px;width:180px;height:180px;border-radius:50%;opacity:.04;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center}
.brand-left{position:relative;z-index:1;flex-shrink:0}
.brand-logo{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:contain;background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);padding:2px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.32),0 0 1px 5px rgba(255,255,255,.05);animation:logoBreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes logoBreathe{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.32),0 0 1px 5px rgba(255,255,255,.05)}50%{box-shadow:0 8px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.38),0 0 2px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.03)}}
.brand-center{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;position:relative;z-index:1;min-width:0}
.brand-name{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.97);letter-spacing:.10em;line-height:1.15;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.brand-motto{font-size:.66rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);letter-spacing:.10em;font-weight:500}
.brand-verse{font-size:.60rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.brand-verse+.brand-verse{margin-top:0}
.brand-subtitle{font-size:.52rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);letter-spacing:.10em;font-weight:400}
.brand-tags{display:flex;gap:8px}
.brand-tag{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:9999px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.04em;transition:all .25s ease;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;text-align:center;min-height:38px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.brand-tag.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);color:#8B1A2B;font-weight:700}
.brand-tag:not(.active){background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}
.brand-tag:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.brand-tag:hover:not(.active){background:rgba(255,255,255,.24)}

/* Chapter Strip */
.chapter-strip{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--paper-warm);border-radius:var(--r-lg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-line);-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none}
.chapter-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.chapter-chip{padding:8px 20px;border-radius:9999px;font-size:.70rem;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.03em;transition:all .25s ease;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;min-height:42px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.chapter-chip:not(.active){background:rgba(28,25,23,.04);color:var(--ink-soft);border:1px solid rgba(28,25,23,.08)}
.chapter-chip.active{background:#8B1A2B;color:#FFF;border:1px solid #8B1A2B}
.chapter-chip:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.chapter-chip:hover:not(.active){background:rgba(28,25,23,.08)}
.chapter-chip:hover:not(.active){border-color:var(--red-border);color:var(--ink)}

/* Progress Area */
/* Apple Liquid Glass — 仪表盘 */
/* 岳麓山仪表盘 — 实景图为底，数据玻璃叠上 */
.progress-area{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:18px 16px;margin:16px 2px 0;border-radius:20px;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background-image:url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center}
/* 暗色遮罩 */
.progress-area::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(26,20,22,.40) 0%,rgba(107,29,43,.25) 100%);border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none}
.progress-area .ring-wrap,.progress-area .progress-info{position:relative;z-index:2}
.ring-wrap{position:relative;width:58px;height:58px;flex-shrink:0}
.ring-wrap svg{width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.ring-center{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ring-num{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.90);line-height:1.1}
.ring-label{font-size:.48rem;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.50);letter-spacing:.04em}
.progress-info{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.progress-info .pi-chapter{font-size:.88rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.90);font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.02em}
.progress-info .pi-stats{font-size:.68rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.60);font-weight:400;line-height:1.4}
.progress-info .pi-stats strong{color:rgba(255,255,255,.90);font-weight:700}
.ring-wrap circle:first-child{stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.10)}
.ring-wrap circle:last-child{stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}

/* Footer */
.home-footer{text-align:center;padding:20px 16px 2px}
.home-footer .ft-motto{display:block;font-size:.64rem;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.10em;font-weight:600;opacity:.7}
.home-footer .ft-sword{font-size:.56rem;color:rgba(28,25,23,.25);letter-spacing:.14em;margin-top:4px;display:block}

/* 入场动画已移除 —— 切章节/学科重建HTML时opacity:0→1导致闪烁 */
.home-wrap .ent-1,.home-wrap .ent-2,.home-wrap .ent-3,.home-wrap .ent-4,.home-wrap .ent-5,.home-wrap .ent-6,
.tab-gate-ent,.tab-seal-ent,.tab-debate-ent,.tab-ascent-ent{opacity:1;transform:none}
.home-wrap.animate-in .ent-1,.home-wrap.animate-in .ent-2,.home-wrap.animate-in .ent-3,.home-wrap.animate-in .ent-4,.home-wrap.animate-in .ent-5,.home-wrap.animate-in .ent-6,
.home-wrap.animate-in .tab-gate-ent,.home-wrap.animate-in .tab-seal-ent,.home-wrap.animate-in .tab-debate-ent,.home-wrap.animate-in .tab-ascent-ent{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* 6.3" Phone (414px) */
@media screen and (min-width:390px) and (max-width:430px){
  .brand-hero{padding:24px 20px 54px}
  .brand-logo{width:80px;height:80px}
  .module-grid{gap:11px}
  .tab-gate{padding:16px 18px}
  .tab-debate .debate-left,.tab-debate .debate-right{min-height:60px}
@media screen and (max-width:389px){
  .brand-hero{padding:18px 14px 48px;gap:10px}
  .brand-logo{width:68px;height:68px}
  .brand-name{font-size:1.1rem}
  .module-icon{width:38px;height:38px}
  .module-title{font-size:.74rem}
}

/* Reduce motion - cleaned */

/* Num pop */


@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  :root{--t-fast:0ms;--t-normal:0ms;--t-slow:0ms;--t-breath:0ms}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:0ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:0ms!important}
  .brand-logo{animation:none!important}
  .seal-img{animation:none!important}
}

/* ============================================================
   6.3英寸 iPhone 专属精细调校 (390-430px)
   三套Skill协同: taste-skills + impeccable + emilkowalski
   ============================================================ */
@media(min-width:390px) and (max-width:430px){
  /* 容器呼吸感 —— impeccable像素级对齐 */
  :root{--max-width:430px}
  .home-wrap{padding:12px}
  .home-card{padding:20px 16px 22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.60)}
  /* 壁纸比例完美呈现 */
  body::before{background-size:100% auto;background-position:center top}
  /* 英雄区校徽与文字黄金比例 */
  .brand-logo{width:72px;height:72px}
  .brand-name{font-size:1.08rem}
  .brand-motto{font-size:.68rem}
  /* 毛玻璃液态质感 —— emilkowalski弹簧物理 */
  .glass-tab{padding:10px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(170%)}
  /* 进度环精细尺寸 */
  .ring-wrap{width:58px;height:58px}
  .ring-num{font-size:.92rem}
  /* 模块卡片舒适触控 —— 44px最小触控区 */
  .tab-gate{padding:16px 18px}
  .tab-debate .debate-left,.tab-debate .debate-right{min-height:62px}
  /* 选项按钮舒适间距 */
  .option{padding:15px 16px}
  .option-text{font-size:.83rem}
  /* 胶囊导航底部安全区精确留白 */
  .quiz-card-wrap{padding-bottom:calc(18px + var(--safe-bottom))}
}



/* Hero-integrated chapter chips */
/* .hero-chapters merged into .hero-bottom */
/* removed: hero-chapters-old */
.hero-chapters::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}

/* removed */


/* Unified Hero Card */
.hero-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--r-lg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;margin-bottom:2px;-webkit-mask-image:-webkit-radial-gradient(white,black);transform:translateZ(0);animation:hnu-imperial-presence 12s ease-in-out infinite}
.hero-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(26,20,22,.65) 0%,rgba(107,29,43,.55) 100%);border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none}
.hero-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:24px;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,rgba(181,52,58,.05) 40%,var(--paper) 100%);pointer-events:none}
.hero-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:22px 16px 14px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero-bottom{padding:6px 16px 14px;position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.hero-bottom::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.hero-bottom .chapter-chip{padding:8px 20px;border-radius:9999px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.03em;transition:all .25s ease;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.hero-bottom .chapter-chip.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#8B1A2B;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.hero-bottom .chapter-chip:not(.active){background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)}
.hero-bottom .chapter-chip:active{transform:scale(.98);transition:transform .1s ease}
.hero-brand-tags{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1;align-self:flex-start;margin-top:4px}


@media screen and (max-width:389px){
  .brand-logo{width:64px;height:64px}
  .brand-name{font-size:1.1rem}
  .brand-verse{font-size:.56rem}
  .hero-top{gap:8px;padding:18px 12px 12px}
  .hero-bottom{padding:4px 12px 14px}
  .hero-bottom .chapter-chip{padding:5px 12px;font-size:.62rem;min-height:40px}
  .hero-brand-tags{gap:4px}
  .brand-tag{padding:5px 10px;font-size:.6rem}
  .tab-gate{padding:14px 12px}
  .gate-emblem{width:32px;height:32px}
  .gate-title{font-size:.74rem}
  .seal-icon{width:28px;height:28px}
  .seal-title{font-size:.72rem}
  .progress-area{padding:12px 14px}
  .ring-wrap{width:54px;height:54px}
  .ring-num{font-size:.82rem}
  .page-sub{font-size:.62rem}
  /* quiz-hero 小屏适配 */
  .quiz-hero{min-height:150px;padding:16px 12px;gap:10px}
  .quiz-hero-logo{width:50px;height:50px}
  .quiz-hero-name{font-size:.88rem}
  .quiz-hero-motto{font-size:.6rem}
  .quiz-hero-verse{font-size:.54rem}
}


/* ---- HNU Easter Eggs ---- */
.maple-particle{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:999;animation:mapleFall 1.3s var(--ease-smooth) forwards;opacity:0}
@keyframes mapleFall{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-50px) rotate(0deg) scale(.4)}15%{opacity:.55}80%{opacity:.4}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(120px) rotate(200deg) scale(.25)}}
.milestone-toast{position:fixed;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.6);z-index:1100;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;animation:msPop .8s var(--ease-spring) forwards;opacity:0}
.milestone-inner{background:rgba(28,25,23,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px);border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:24px 32px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.milestone-inner .ms-icon{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.milestone-inner .ms-title{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);letter-spacing:.06em}
.milestone-inner .ms-sub{font-size:.64rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);margin-top:5px;letter-spacing:.12em}
@keyframes msPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.5)}55%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.05)}85%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.98)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}}
.quiz-watermark{position:absolute;bottom:6px;right:14px;font-size:.5rem;color:rgba(28,25,23,.05);letter-spacing:.18em;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;user-select:none}

/* ============================================================
   多选专项 — 确认按钮
   ============================================================ */
.multi-confirm-wrap{text-align:center;margin-top:var(--s-3);}
.multi-confirm-btn{padding:10px 40px;font-size:.88rem;border-radius:var(--r-lg);}
.multi-confirm-btn:disabled{opacity:.35;pointer-events:none;}

/* ============================================================
   简答专项 — 答案展示
   ============================================================ */
.short-answer-wrap{text-align:center;margin:var(--s-3) 0;}
.short-reveal-btn{padding:12px 36px;font-size:.88rem;border-radius:var(--r-lg);}
.short-answer-reveal{background:var(--pine-subtle);border:1px solid var(--pine);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:var(--s-3);text-align:left;margin-top:var(--s-2);}
.short-answer-label{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--pine);letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:var(--s-1);}
.short-answer-text{font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink);}
